# Label propagation of Longitudinal mTBI subjects

## 1. Baseline vs. Longitudinal data of longitudinal mTBI subjects

We are interested in knowing, how effective is our baseline cluster solution at explaining CBCL levels within our longitudinal sample?
If our clustering is primarily informing us about risk-factors, we should expect that the baseline (pre-injury) data of the longitudinal mTBI subjects will be highly informative of their behaviour separations.
On the other hand, if our cluster solution is primarily driven by the injury, we should expect that the longitudinal data will be more informative of the behaviour separations.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(abcdutils)
library(here)
library(metasnf)
library(progressr)
library(rlist)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

input_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/inputs")))
proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
fig_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))
sub_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/subjects")))
```

```{r}
# The longitudinal subject data
all_dls_l <- list.load(input_path("2024_06_18_all_dls_l.rds"))

# The baseline subject data
all_dls_b <- list.load(input_path("2024_04_19_all_dls.rds"))

# The baseline solution
mtbi_mc_d_full_esm <- read_csv(proc_path("2024_07_22_mtbi_mc_d_full_esm.csv"))
```

I will check to see how good of a fit the baseline data of the longitudinal subjects is to the baseline solution.

```{r}
jitter_dodged_outcomes <- function(df, outcomes) {
    plot_list <- list()
    for (outcome in outcomes) {
        plot <- df |>
        ggplot(
            aes(
                x = cluster,
                y = .data[[outcome]],
                group = interaction(cluster, time),
                fill = time,
                colour = time,
                shape = group
            )
        ) +
        geom_jitter(
            size = 3,
            alpha = 0.4,
            position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.3)
        ) +
        geom_violin(
            alpha = 0.1,
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)
        ) +
        stat_summary(
            fun = "mean",
            geom = "crossbar",
            colour = "black",
            linewidth = 2.3,
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)
        ) +
        stat_summary(
            fun = "mean",
            size = 5,
            geom = "text", aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 2)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)
        ) + 
        theme_bw() +
        labs(
            x = "Label Propagated Cluster",
            fill = "Timepoint",
            colour = "Timepoint"
        )
        plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- plot
    }
    return(plot_list)
}

preinj_v_change_df <- dplyr::inner_join(loom_df, loomdf_t0, by = "subjectkey")

preinj_v_change <- function(df, outcomes) {
    plot_list <- list()
    for (outcome in outcomes) {
        outcome_0 <- paste0(outcome, "_0")
        outcome_d <- paste0(outcome, "_d")
        plot <- df |>
        ggplot(
            aes(
                x = .data[[outcome_0]],
                y = .data[[outcome_d]],
                group = cluster,
                colour = cluster
            )
        ) +
        geom_jitter(
            data = df |> dplyr::filter(cluster != "none"),
            size = 2.5,
            alpha = 0.5
        ) +
        geom_smooth(
            method = "lm",
            alpha = 0.2
        ) +
        labs(
            x = paste0(outcome, " (preinjury)"),
            y = paste0(outcome, " (pre-to-post change)"),
            group = "predicted cluster",
            colour = "predicted cluster",
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(text = element_text(size = 18))
        plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- plot
    }
    return(plot_list)
}
```

Here I check how the longitudinal subjects map onto our initial baseline mTBI solution.

```{r}

    proc_path(
        "2024_07_22_mtbi_mc_d_full_data_list.rds"

# Remove injury variables from baseline data list
preinjury_components <- summarize_dl(mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_1)$"name"
mtbi_b_components <- summarize_dl(mtbi_b_data_list)$"name"
keep_components <- mtbi_b_components %in% preinjury_components

mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi <- mtbi_b_data_list[keep_components]

# Remove inclusion injury variables from baseline solutions matrix
mtbi_mc_d_esm_no_mtbi <- mtbi_mc_d_full_esm |>
    dplyr::select(
        -dplyr::contains(
            c(
                "mtbi_mem_daze",
                "mtbi_mechanism",
                "mtbi_loc",
                "mtbi_age",
                "previous_mtbis"
            )
        )
    )

summarize_dl(mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_1)

summarize_dl(mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi)

mtbi_b_l0_imp_1_dl <- merge_data_lists(
    mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi,
    mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_1
)

mtbi_b_l0_imp_2_dl <- merge_data_lists(
    mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi,
    mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_2
)

mtbi_b_l0_imp_3_dl <- merge_data_lists(
    mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi,
    mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_3
)

mtbi_b_l0_imp_4_dl <- merge_data_lists(
    mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi,
    mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_4
)

mtbi_b_l0_imp_5_dl <- merge_data_lists(
    mtbi_b_data_list_no_mtbi,
    mtbi_l0_data_list_imp_5
)

list.save(mtbi_b_l0_imp_1_dl, proc_path("mtbi_b_l0_imp_1_dl.rds", TRUE))
list.save(mtbi_b_l0_imp_2_dl, proc_path("mtbi_b_l0_imp_2_dl.rds", TRUE))
list.save(mtbi_b_l0_imp_3_dl, proc_path("mtbi_b_l0_imp_3_dl.rds", TRUE))

list.save(mtbi_b_l0_imp_5_dl, proc_path("mtbi_b_l0_imp_5_dl.rds", TRUE))
```

Effect size prep

```{r}
effect_size_raw <- function(x1, x2) {
    n1 <- length(x1)
    n2 <- length(x2)
    s1 <- sd(x1)
    s2 <- sd(x2)
    s <- pooled_sd(n1, s1, n2, s2)
    mean1 <- mean(x1)
    mean2 <- mean(x2)
    d <- cohens_d(mean1, mean2, s)
    return(d)
}

pooled_sd <- function(n1, s1, n2, s2) {
    numerator <- ((n1 - 1) * (s1^2)) + ((n2 - 1) * (s2^2))
    denominator <- n1 + n2 - 2
    s <- sqrt(numerator / denominator)
    return(s)
}

cohens_d <- function(mean1, mean2, pooled_sd) {
    d <- (mean1 - mean2) / pooled_sd
    return(d)
}

tstat <- function(d, n1, n2) {
    t <- d * sqrt((n1 * n2) / (n1 + n2))
    return(t)
}

es_bound <- function(d, n1, n2) {
    t <- tstat(d, n1, n2)
    es_data <- compute.es::tes(
        t = t,
        n.1 = n1,
        n.2 = n2,
        verbose = FALSE
    )
    return(
        list(
            "lower" = es_data$"l.d",
            "upper" = es_data$"u.d"
        )
    )
}
```
